name: Samurai castle keep
desc: the tiered donjon of a Japanese castle, seat of a lord and the last place to fall
tags: japanese castle keep, tiered white plaster tower, curved tile roofs with upturned eaves, gold roof ornament, massive sloped stone base, narrow wooden windows, dark timber beams, pine trees at the foot, moat water
prose: a Japanese castle keep rising in white plaster tiers above a massive sloped stone base, its curved tile roofs turning up at the eaves, pines at its foot and moat water beyond
note: Drifts to a Chinese palace or a plain pagoda. Three nouns pin it: the SLOPED stone base it stands on, white plaster walls banded with dark timber, and tiers that step inward as they rise. A pagoda has no stone base - if the base is missing you have rendered the wrong building and no amount of 'samurai' in the prompt fixes it.
